en.hero.lede: Today I'm building Lienox: an app where teams of AI agents work on your own machine.
en.hero.sceneAlt: Portrait of Diego Gaxiola on a stack of printing plates
en.spotlight.lead: A local-first desktop app where teams of AI agents work in parallel, on your own machine and with your own keys.
en.spotlight.cap1.d: Sales, support, marketing, operations and code, each with its own role.
en.spotlight.cap2.d: Describe the outcome and Lienox assembles the flow; several agents work in parallel.
en.spotlight.cap3.d: They run on their own, 24/7, with evidence-backed verification.
en.spotlight.cap4.d: Delegate by talking; every agent gets its own tab with a visible cursor.
en.orchestra.title: Lienox coordinating agents in parallel
en.orchestra.desc: A request arrives by voice or as a scheduled task, Lienox splits it across sales, support, marketing, operations and code agents, and every result comes back verified.
en.orchestra.caption: One request, several agents in parallel, every result verified.
